paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the F1 score results for different variants of the MADLLM model across various datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 80 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored green, purple, and orange, corresponding to MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, respectively. The green bars have values ranging from approximately 91 for SWaT to 97 for PSM. The purple bars range from around 86 for SWaT to 94 for PSM. The orange bars range from about 86 for SWaT to 93 for PSM. The groups are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a comparison of the F1 scores achieved by the different model variants on the various datasets.
